_comment: Ordinal latency tier per model_id. small-open=1, large-open=2, flagship-proprietary=3. Used for T_alt2 construction (deliberately coarse, decorrelated from Q).

_tier_definitions.1: small-open: open-weight models <= 13B params OR small proprietary (e.g. mini/haiku/flash variants)
_tier_definitions.2: large-open: open-weight models > 13B params (e.g. 70B, 405B Llama variants, large MoE)
_tier_definitions.3: flagship-proprietary: closed-weight flagship models (GPT-4o, Claude-3-Opus, Gemini-1.5-Pro)

gpt-3.5-turbo.source: Older OpenAI model, lighter than GPT-4 class

claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022.source: Flagship proprietary from Anthropic (Sonnet is mid-high tier)

claude-3-opus-20240229.source: Flagship proprietary from Anthropic (heaviest Claude model)

gemini-1.5-flash.source: Small proprietary from Google (Flash = fast variant)

gemini-2.0-flash.source: Small proprietary from Google (Flash = fast variant)
